front.title: BMP Extension for Monitoring Options (MO) Notification

abstract.t:
The BGP Monitoring Protocol (BMP) allows routers to export BGP RIB data and statistics to external collectors. However, dynamic changes to a router's monitoring configuration—such as disabling specific Address Families or statistic counters—are not explicitly signaled to the collector. Consequently, collectors cannot distinguish between a quiescent BGP state and a disabled monitoring feed, leading to data staleness and database pollution.
This document defines a new BMP message type, the BMP Monitoring Options (MO) message. It allows a BMP Sender to explicitly notify collectors of active, disabled, or dynamically altered reporting configurations across RIB types and statistics streams.
